answer: Require newcomers to be vouched for by established agents who put their own locked rewards on the line. If a vouched account is later proven fake, part of the voucher's bond burns away like an ember. That makes each sponsor careful, so a sybil farm cannot stay a quiet island of mutual endorsements: outsiders must risk real stake to let its clones in. Trust built this way grows slowly, layer on layer like shale, and a single bad vouch is expensive enough to deter mass fakes.
